hero.eyebrow: Remodeling & handyman services in North Apollo
hero.headline: Remodeling and home repairs in North Apollo, done right the first time.
hero.subhead: Kitchen and bathroom remodels, flooring, drywall, painting and the plumbing and electrical fixes other contractors don't have time for. Tell us about the job and get a free quote.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the Hilltop Handymen and Remodeling assistant. Got a remodel in mind or a repair that can't wait? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a free quote or book a time.

about.headline: Big remodel or small fix, it gets the same care.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a contractor: someone who actually shows up, explains what's going on, and gives a price before the work starts. That goes for a full bathroom remodel and for a leaking pipe or a broken step that can't wait a week.

cards.title: Rooms ready for a remodel
cards.body: Kitchens and bathrooms rebuilt from the floor up, with flooring, drywall and paint to finish.

cards.title: Repairs that can't wait
cards.body: Leaks, broken steps and electrical problems handled fast, often the same or next day.

cards.title: Small jobs others turn down
cards.body: A new hose bib, a light fixture or an outlet. Small jobs done properly, not put off.

about.closing: Not sure if it's a big job or a small one? Tell us what's going on and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Getting a contractor in North Apollo to call back shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: You call around and get told it'll be a week, or nobody calls back at all.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: No price up front, then a bill that's bigger than you expected.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: A start date that keeps moving while the bathroom sits half-finished.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Drywall dust and offcuts left through the house after every visit.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear answer and a quote.

solutions.headline: Straightforward remodeling and repairs with clear communication.

services.title: Kitchen & bathroom remodels
services.body: Kitchen and bathroom builds and remodels, planned with you and finished properly.

services.title: Flooring, drywall & painting
services.body: Flooring and carpet installation, drywall and painting to finish a room or refresh the house.

services.title: Plumbing & electrical repairs
services.body: Leaks, fixtures, hose bibs, lights and outlets fixed promptly, with a clear explanation of what was wrong.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Do it right.

steps.title: Request your free quote
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a call. A rough idea of the job is plenty.

steps.title: Visit & clear scope
steps.body: We take a look, explain what's needed and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: On-time, tidy work
steps.body: We show up when we say we will and keep the work area clean.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished job with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

realReviews.author: Kimberly Held
realReviews.text: I called them due to not being able to get someone through a plumbing services. They said I would have to wait about a week and I couldn't wait that long due to water dripping down into my other bathroom. Hilltop Handyman and Remodeling came to my house that day and came back to finish next morning. They gave me great ideas for other projects that I would like them to do also. They were on time, convenient, very helpful, great service. I would call them again for any project. Thank you so much for your service, I was very pleased. Until next time!!!

realReviews.author: Alex Cupec
realReviews.text: We reached out to Hilltop Contracting and Remodeling to handle the installation of a hose bib outside. It seemed like plumbers didn’t have the time to do a relatively small job but Hilltop was more than willing to take this on. Communication was easy and they were super timely and efficient. Honest guys and quality work. 100% would recommend them to anyone.

realReviews.author: Durrell Waters
realReviews.text: I called hilltop contracting and was treated with such kindness and professionalism it couldn’t be matched . My steps need repaired the day before Christmas Eve and I thought surely I would have to wait for service and at the very best after new years . Instead Michael Garlick not only assessed the situation and gave me an estimate but he repaired the stairs inside of 24 hours of my call! Hilltop contracting and Michael Garlick saved my family Christmas and I couldn’t be more appreciative. I wish I could give hilltop contracting 10 stars ! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  I will be calling for all my remodeling needs in the future and tell all my friends !
